A01.name: Future data inserted into historical period
A01.rationale: No future data used; only historical FRED observations

A02.name: Incorrect date alignment
A02.rationale: Observation dates used directly from FRED; no manual alignment

A03.name: Duplicate observations
A03.rationale: FRED provides unique daily observations; duplicates checked in quality audit

A04.name: Missing data silently filled
A04.rationale: Missing values documented; forward-fill only used in feature construction with explicit handling

A05.name: Revised values treated as PIT-native
A05.rationale: Minor revisions documented; vintage treatment not required for Treasury yields

A06.name: Simulated data mislabeled as real
A06.rationale: Real data has explicit origin='fred_csv'; simulated data is in Phase 31-R only

A07.name: Real and simulated data mixed
A07.rationale: Separate directories enforced; origin metadata validated

A08.name: Incorrect maturity mapping
A08.rationale: Series IDs match FRED identifiers exactly

A09.name: Lookback leakage
A09.rationale: All lookbacks use historical data only; no future information

A10.name: Forward-filled future observation
A10.rationale: Forward-fill uses last available observation; no future values

A11.name: Dataset hash mismatch
A11.rationale: SHA-256 hashes computed and stored for all files

A13.name: Missing publication metadata
A13.rationale: Publication timing documented for all series

A14.name: Structural break hidden
A14.rationale: Data quality audit checks for discontinuities
